brief_title: A Study of the Efficacy and Safety of Semaglutide Injection in the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label, and Parallel Assignment Phase III Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Semaglutide Injection With Ozempic® in Combination With Metformin in the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes

lead_sponsor.name: Hangzhou Jiuyuan Gene Engineering Co. Ltd.,

primary_outcomes.measure: The observed mean change in Glycosylated Haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) values from baseline after 32 weeks of treatment.

brief_summary: Semaglutide injection is a new drug developed according to Ozempic® biosimilars.This trial is conducted in China. The purpose of this study is to investigate the similarities in the efficacy and safety of semaglutide injection and Ozempic® in the treatment of type 2 diabetes, respectively.
